info.name: Poultry Sathi API
info.description:
Shop API for Poultry Sathi. Base path is `/api/v1`.

Import `Local.postman_environment.json` and select it before sending.
Set `phoneNumber` to a registered shop-admin phone (`+91` and 10 digits), run **Login — send OTP**, copy the OTP into `otp`, then run **Login — verify OTP**. That request saves `accessToken` for every other folder.

Live test on 25 Sep 2026: 69/71 called requests returned 2xx. Saved examples are those responses. Write requests (create, update, delete, register, webhook) are documented and were not executed.

Collection auth is Bearer `{{accessToken}}`. Login, register, health, and the Razorpay webhook send no token.
